metadata.title: MAPP 5200.7 Rev.1 ANDA Amendments and Supplements Reviewed by the Division of Filing Review
metadata.legal_basis: CDER Manual of Policies and Procedures (internal FDA review procedure). Informative; not binding on applicants.
metadata.applicability: FDA staff procedure. Category: Generic Drug Review.

candidates.statement: Effective Date: 11/12/15 4/17/2020; 11/29/2024 Page 1 of 7 POLICY AND PROCEDURES OFFICE OF GENERIC DRUGS ANDA Amendments and Supplements Reviewed by the Division of Filing Review Table of Contents PURPOSE ..............................................................................1 POLICY .................................................................................1 RESPONSIBILITIES AND PROCEDURES .....................2 EFFECTIVE DATE ..............................................................4 CHANGE CONTROL TABLE............................................4 ATTACHMENT 1: Checklist: Should This Submission be Sent to the Division of Filing Review? .......5 ATTACHMENT 2: Work Guide for Prior Approval Supplements: Requirements for a Filing Review ...............6 PURPOSE This MAPP outlines policies and procedures for the Office of Generic Drugs (OGD), the Center for Drug Evaluation and Research Central Document Room (Document Room), and the Office of Pharmaceutical Quality (OPQ) to determine whether an amendment or supplement should be reviewed by OGD’s Division of Filing Review (DFR).
candidates.context: POLICY OGD’s DFR reviews each original abbreviated new drug application (ANDA) submitted to OGD to evaluate whether an ANDA may be received or refused for receipt pursuant to FDA’s regulations at 21 CFR 314.101, which provide the regulatory authority by which FDA may in certain cases, and will in others, refuse to receive (RTR) an ANDA.

candidates.statement: • If the criterion above is not met, the assessment team should conduct a case-by- case evaluation to see if the change may be appropriately submitted as a CBE supplement rather than a PAS.
candidates.context: • A restart at a new manufacturing site of a type of operation that has been discontinued for more than two years will require a PAS. • If a CBE supplement is appropriate, a filing review is not needed.
